comments.author: zaynabhadd
comments.body: UNSIGNED ARTIFACT — this dev image has no signature attached and an unsigned image anywhere near the pipeline is a supply-chain incident waiting to happen. Nothing here moves until signing is sorted!

comments.author: aaravsharma
comments.body: Agreed signing matters for release images; for this dev-only image the signing decision sits with the release board, which has not ruled yet. The thread waits on their call — the image itself is dev-scoped and unchanged.
